summary: Ganas Ventures is a Latina-led fund run by general partner Lolita Taub that invests in pre-seed and seed community-driven startups across the United States and Latin America. Its homepage gives a portfolio snapshot of 40% pre-seed and 60% seed, split between the United States and Latin America including Mexico, Costa Rica, El Salvador and Brazil, and describes a scout and community network. Founders apply through a linked form. Check size, sector focus and a street address are not published.

investmentEvidence.fact: Portfolio founder Gina Gotthilf is quoted on the homepage on Ganas being a fit for Latitud. Round and date are not stated.
Named on the homepage among portfolio companies sourced through deal partners. Round and date are not stated.

sources.title: Homepage: stage, US and Latin America focus, general partner, portfolio snapshot and application link
